limits: No live provider, real audio/hearing, legal-consent, profile-quality or commercial acceptance proof.

Native speech is degraded to one exact truthful acknowledgement while DNC is unacknowledged. A new accepted final caller turn can coalesce one idempotent persistence retry; no retry per delta/duplicate or durable recovery queue.

OpenAI repair token, response ID, epoch and current caller revision are checked; xAI metadata echo is unverified. An interrupted unresolved xAI repair remains speech-unavailable and diagnosed, not silently treated as recovered.

Audio already submitted before delayed final DNC cannot be recalled. The remainder is cancelled/truncated and partial delivery remains interrupted/unknown; no full reply replay or invented unheard/heard claim.
Exact transcript admission trusts the existing complete provider audio/transcript pairing; synthetic tests cannot prove acoustic fidelity.
DNC acknowledgement means the durable suppression row was acknowledged, separately from full queue/lead cleanup. Existing schema/runtime tests remain separate evidence.
Persistent DB failure, process death, unfinished recording expiry/export/delete acceptance, and real provider/profile qualification remain open.
